fields.description: Restricts each listed User to only see Employee Checkin / Attendance / Clocking Adjustment records for employees whose home Branch is listed here. A user with no row here is unrestricted (sees every branch).
fields.label: Responsible HR per Branch

fields.description: Maps a physical clocking device/terminal ID (as it appears in legacy .DAT rows and in Employee Checkin.device_id from HIKVision) to the Branch it belongs to - used as a last-resort Branch source when a checkin's employee has no Branch of their own and the import it came from has no Fallback Branch set (see is_attendance.controllers.clocking_import's create_checkins). New rows are added here automatically (Branch left blank) whenever a Clocking * Import job completes and encounters a device not already listed - just fill in its Branch, or leave it blank to keep relying on Employee/Fallback Branch for that device.
fields.label: Clocking Machines

fields.description: Maps each Leave Type to the single-letter code Sage VIP Premier expects on a payroll batch import (A = Annual, S = Sick, F = Family Responsibility). Read directly by is_attendance.controllers.sage_payroll - a Leave Type with no row here is simply left out of a Sage Payroll Run's computed leave hours.
fields.label: Leave Type → Sage Leave Code
